fact: The government commission reported 5.3 million families enrolled in the RSU, and that the RSU-registered families received the exceptional school-start aid (over 1.8 million families) and are the base for the direct social aid programme (about 4 million families).

Les Eco, citing the Ministry of Interior, says each household member must hold an RNP-issued digital civil and social identifier (IDCS) to register in the RSU and to authenticate for programme benefits, with RNP and RSU generalised to all regions by mid-May 2023.

Les Eco, citing the Ministry of Interior, says the RSU is the main targeting mechanism for social support programmes, with 1.8 million households enrolled of 3.5 million targeted for 2023 and a socio-economic index used by programmes to target households.

The World Bank-financed second project (2024-2028, US$70 million) supports RNP digital authentication and eKYC services to be used across social programmes and the national rollout of the RSU as the gateway for all social safety net programmes.

The RSU information system registers households through automated verification of the head of household's declared data against more than 30 administrative databases via the government interoperability platform, per the Ministry of Interior document; the date of this statement is not given, so the publication date is used.

The Ministry of Interior document says the RSU, which held 4.1 million households (40% of the population) at 31 December 2023, serves to target social protection programmes, and that the RNP is used by social protection programmes.
The ADD says Jisr is used for data exchange in the unified social registry and the Tayssir family financial support programme.

The ID4Africa slide lists health insurance for vulnerable groups, direct cash transfer, higher education scholarship and health insurance for non-covered groups as achievements under the RNP-RSU system.
The common interconnection platform carries about 170,000 RSU operations a day (to August 2023), per the minister.
The ADD says the GISRE platform carries data exchange for operational use cases including the Registre social unifié and AMO Tadamon.
